repos.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
repos.eli5: ThinkRail is like a smart notebook that learns how you code and then helps you write code faster by suggesting the right tools and remembering your project’s rules. Programmers use it to boost productivity.

repos.name: makecindy/cindy

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC

repos.name: pbakaus/impeccable
repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.eli5: Impeccable is a style coach for AI code generators, telling them not to use the same boring designs over and over. AI developers use it to make their generated websites look fresh.

repos.name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
repos.description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

repos.name: pollen-robotics/microduck
repos.eli5: Microduck is a tiny robot duck that can walk, roll, and pick things up, controlled by a tiny brain that learns how to move. Hobbyists and researchers use it to experiment with robot learning.

repos.name: nightly-labs/openbot

repos.eli5: OpenBot is a desktop playground where you can keep several AI helpers alive, each with its own desk, files, and chat, so they can work together on projects. Developers use it to manage AI assistants locally.

repos.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
